en.hubeali: And by this chain, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
The most diligent of the people in rituals is the one most sincere in advising them, and the most submissive of them in hearts to the entirety of the Muslims’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is reported through the same chain of narrators who has said the following: “The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘
The most assiduous worshipper among the people is the one whose inner center is most clean and whose heart is most peaceful toward Muslims.’”
